Posts since 11-19 aren't flagged, but they also never got a For You push (that's when reviews happen), so the same risk applies to the current format. restricted_posts.rule: TikTok posts need real transformation (at least one of: Justin's voice line, an explainer edit with freeze-frame + on-screen explanation of the mechanic, or a multi-streamer story/compilation), on top of the 3-of-5 originality checklist.
